description: This file defines an abstract Scala class 'ThreadSafeDittoLoggingAdapter' that extends 'LoggingAdapter' and adds thread-safe methods for managing correlation IDs in logging, including setting, deriving from headers, and discarding correlation IDs.

classes.name: ThreadSafeDittoLoggingAdapter
classes.description: An abstract thread-safe Scala class extending LoggingAdapter, providing methods to manage correlation IDs for logging in a concurrent environment.

methods.name: withCorrelationId
methods.description: Sets a correlation ID for log operations, returning a new logger instance with the correlation ID.

methods.name: withCorrelationId
methods.description: Derives a correlation ID from WithDittoHeaders for log operations, returning a new logger instance.

methods.name: withCorrelationId
methods.description: Obtains a correlation ID from DittoHeaders for log operations, returning a new logger instance.

methods.name: discardCorrelationId
methods.description: Removes the current correlation ID from the logger, returning a logger without a correlation ID.
